mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FROM maintenance_tasks a LEFT JOIN maintenance_plan b ON a.plan_id = b.id where a.maintenance_task_status = 'BE_MAINTAINED' and (b.responsibility_person_id like CONCAT('%',#{param.userId},'%') or b.receive_dept_id like CONCAT('%',#{param.organization},'%') or b.receive_post_id like CONCAT('%',#{param.position},'%'))

SELECT a.id, a.object_name objectName, a.maintenance_time maintenanceTime, a.category_code categoryCode, a.category_name categoryName, a.maintenance_finish_time maintenanceFinishTime, a.maintenance_task_status maintenanceTaskStatus, a.maintenance_task_person maintenanceTaskPerson, a.code code, a.picture picture, a.task_remark taskRemark, b.maintenance_plan_name maintenancePlanName, b.responsibility_type responsibilityType, b.receive_dept_id receiveDeptId, b.receive_post_id receivePostId, b.responsibility_person_id responsibilityPersonId FROM maintenance_tasks a LEFT JOIN maintenance_plan b ON a.plan_id = b.id where a.id = #{id}
SELECT IF( COUNT( 1 ) = SUM( IF ( maintenance_task_status = 'COMPLETED', 1, 0 ) ), 1, 0 ) choose FROM maintenance_tasks where plan_id = #{planId} GROUP BY plan_id
SELECT a.id id, a.maintenance_content maintenanceContent FROM maintenance_project a LEFT JOIN maintenance_object_projects b ON a.id = b.project_id WHERE b.object_id = #{objectId}

update.foreach: update maintenance_proget_record set record = #{item.record},maintenance_describe =#{item.maintenanceDescribe} where id =#{item.id}
